title: Distribution of a raw projected restriction batch
statement: Let $n,M,R$ be natural numbers, let $f$ map sign vectors on $n$ coordinates to signs, let $P$ be a set of coordinates, and fix a sign assignment $z$ on $P$. Choose uniformly a batch of $R$ sign vectors on all $n$ coordinates, then form the raw projected restriction batch using $f$, $P$, $z$, and $M$. Its distribution equals the distribution obtained by first choosing uniformly a batch of $R$ assignments on $P$, then independently choosing uniformly a batch of $R$ assignments on the complementary coordinates, combining each pair of assignments into a full sign vector, and applying the same raw projection.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a function from sign vectors on $n$ coordinates to signs
$P$ is a set of coordinates among the $n$ indices
